sentences.zh: 我是《纽约时报》每日时事通讯《DealBook》的商业与政策记者。

sentences.zh: 我抓住他了。

sentences.zh: 怎么回事，老兄？

sentences.zh: 你知道我为什么要拦下你吗？

sentences.en: Man, In the spring of 2019, this video started circulating online.
sentences.zh: 老兄，2019年春天，这段视频开始在网上流传。

sentences.en: It showed the police in the city of
sentences.zh: 画面显示了

sentences.en: Louisville in Kentucky making a traffic stop.
sentences.zh: 肯塔基州路易斯维尔市的警察正在进行交通拦截。

sentences.en: The driver was a black teenage boy.
sentences.zh: 司机是一名黑人男青少年。

sentences.en: He happened to be his high school's homecoming king and a multiple scholarship winner.
sentences.zh: 他恰好是高中的返校日国王，并获得过多个奖学金。

sentences.en: He had borrowed his mom's car to go buy a slushie at the local store.
sentences.zh: 他借了妈妈的车去当地商店买一杯冰沙。

sentences.en: And he suddenly found himself being pulled out of the car, being handcuffed, being searched for the offense of making a wide turn.
sentences.zh: 然后他突然发现自己被强行拖出车外、戴上手铐，并因转弯幅度过大这一违章行为而被搜身。

sentences.en: And this video that went viral online was far from the first time that something like this had happened in Louisville.
sentences.zh: 这段在网络上疯传的视频，远不是路易斯维尔第一次发生类似的事情。

sentences.en: There's a call now for a review of Metro Police Policy's claims of racial profiling on the part of the white police officer who...
sentences.zh: 现在有人呼吁审查大都会警察局政策中关于涉事白人警官涉嫌种族 profiling（种族定性）的指控……

sentences.en: So in response, the Louisville Police Department enacted a series of reforMs. These changes are meant to reflect our department's values and commitment to fair
sentences.zh: 因此，作为回应，路易斯维尔警察局颁布了一系列改革措施。这些改变旨在体现我们部门的价值观和对公正、

sentences.en: professional interactions with the public.
sentences.zh: 与公众进行专业互动的承诺。

sentences.en: We have work to do in terms of building trust and legitimacy with the people that we have sworn to serve and protect.
sentences.zh: 在与我们宣誓服务和保护的人民建立信任和合法性方面，我们还有很多工作要做。

sentences.en: And yet, those very reforms set into motion a raid that a few months later killed a 26-year-old woman.
sentences.zh: 然而，正是这些改革引发了一场突袭搜查，几个月后夺去了一名 26 岁女子的生命。

sentences.en: We want justice.
sentences.zh: 我们要正义。

sentences.en: We want justice.
sentences.zh: 我们要正义。

sentences.en: Justice for whom?
sentences.zh: 谁的正义？

sentences.en: Her name was Breonna Taylor.
sentences.zh: 她的名字叫布雷娜·泰勒。

sentences.en: Thank you, justice.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你，正义。

sentences.en: From the New York Times, I'm Michael Barbaro.
sentences.zh: 来自《纽约时报》，我是迈克尔·巴巴罗。

sentences.en: This is The Daily.
sentences.zh: 这是《每日新闻》。

sentences.en: Breonna Taylor.
sentences.zh: 布雷娜·泰勒。

sentences.en: Breonna Taylor.
sentences.zh: 布雷娜·泰勒。

sentences.en: Over the past five months, Breonna Taylor.
sentences.zh: 在过去的五个月里，布雷娜·泰勒。

sentences.en: The name Breonna Taylor has become a national rallying cry for those demanding changes in
sentences.zh: 布雷娜·泰勒这个名字已经成为全国要求变革的集结号，

sentences.en: American policing.
sentences.zh: 呼吁改变美国的警务工作。

sentences.en: Protests and celebrities speaking out.
sentences.zh: 抗议活动以及名人纷纷发声。

sentences.en: We feel for it and we want justice.
sentences.zh: 我们感同身受，我们想要正义。

sentences.en: Say her name, Breonna Taylor.
sentences.zh: 说出她的名字，布雷娜·泰勒。

sentences.en: Beyonce is demanding justice for Breonna Taylor.
sentences.zh: 碧昂丝正要求为布雷娜·泰勒伸张正义。

sentences.en: But unlike George Floyd, Eric Garner, or Rayshard Brooks, there's no video capturing the final moments of her life.
sentences.zh: 但与乔治·弗洛伊德、埃里克·加纳或雷沙德·布鲁克斯不同，没有任何视频记录下她生命的最后时刻。

sentences.en: Do you know Breonna Taylor's story, her whole story?
sentences.zh: 你知道布雷娜·泰勒的故事吗，她完整的经历？

sentences.en: Today, a Times investigation pieces together what actually happened to Breonna Taylor.
sentences.zh: 今天，《时报》的一项调查还原了布雷娜·泰勒身上究竟发生了什么。

sentences.en: In part one, Rukmini Kalamaki tells the story of how police ended up at her door.
sentences.zh: 在第一部分中，鲁克米尼·卡拉马基讲述了警察是如何最终来到她家门前的。

sentences.en: It's Wednesday, September 9th.
sentences.zh: 今天是 9 月 9 日，星期三。

sentences.en: All right, let's get started, okay?
sentences.zh: 好吧，我们开始吧，好吗？

sentences.en: Rukmini, where does your reporting start for this story?
sentences.zh: 鲁克米尼，你关于这个故事的报道是从哪里开始的？

sentences.en: So I met my colleague, the documentary filmmaker Yoruba Ritten in Louisville.
sentences.zh: 我在路易斯维尔见到了我的同事，纪录片导演约鲁巴·里滕。

sentences.en: So can you start off by telling me your names and what your relation is to Breonna?
sentences.zh: 那你们能先告诉我你们的名字，以及你们和布雷娜是什么关系吗？

sentences.en: And we spent the next couple of weeks speaking to the people who knew Breonna beSt.
sentences.zh: 接下来的几周里，我们与最了解布雷娜的人进行了交谈。

sentences.en: My name's Tamika Palmer.
sentences.zh: 我叫塔米卡·帕尔默。

sentences.en: I have two daughters.
sentences.zh: 我有两个女儿。

sentences.en: Her mom.
sentences.zh: 她的妈妈。

sentences.en: Breonna Taylor, Janiah Palmer.
sentences.zh: 布雷娜·泰勒，贾尼亚·帕尔默。

sentences.en: My name's Kenneth Walker.
sentences.zh: 我叫肯尼斯·沃克。

sentences.en: Her boyfriend.
sentences.zh: 她的男友。

sentences.en: My name is Breonna Flakes, and I am Breonna's cousin.
sentences.zh: 我叫布雷娜·弗莱克斯，我是布雷娜的表妹。

sentences.en: Her cousins.
sentences.zh: 她的表亲们。

sentences.en: I would say our relationship was more like sisters, twin cousins, pre and Bre.
sentences.zh: 我会说我们的关系更像是姐妹，双胞胎表姐妹，Pre 和 Bre。

sentences.en: Her very best friends, going all the way back to her childhood, her co-workers.
sentences.zh: 她最要好的朋友，一直追溯到她的童年，还有她的同事们。

sentences.en: And in combination with the thousands of pages of documents that I was able to acquire about her case, what comes across is that this is a young woman who was dealt, I would say,
sentences.zh: 结合我能够收集到的关于她案子的数千页文件，给人的印象是，这是一个可以说是生活给了她

sentences.en: a pretty tough hand in life.
sentences.zh: 相当严酷考验的年轻女性。

sentences.en: What was your reaction when you found out you were pregnant?
sentences.zh: 当你发现自己怀孕时，你的反应是什么？

sentences.en: How old were you?
sentences.zh: 你当时多大？

sentences.en: Uh, I was like in disbelief.
sentences.zh: 呃，我当时觉得难以置信。

sentences.en: I was 16 years old though, so.
sentences.zh: 不过我当时16岁，所以。

sentences.en: She was born to a teenage mom.
sentences.zh: 她出生在一个少年妈妈的家庭。

sentences.en: I just knew I had to be a better person then at that point.
sentences.zh: 我当时只知道从那个时候开始我必须做一个更好的人。

sentences.en: So I took it on.
sentences.zh: 所以我承担了下来。

sentences.en: Her dad was convicted on a murder and drug charge when she was just six years old and was sent to prison for the rest of her life.
sentences.zh: 在她只有六岁时，她的父亲因谋杀和毒品罪被定罪，并被判终身监禁。

sentences.en: What was she like as a child?
sentences.zh: 她小时候是个什么样的人？

sentences.en: Breonna was a good kid.
sentences.zh: 布雷娜是个好孩子。

sentences.en: She was easy.
sentences.zh: 她很好带。

sentences.en: Even just as a young kid, she just was, she was smart.
sentences.zh: 即使在很小的时候，她就是，她很聪明。

sentences.en: But what you also see amidst the challenges of her early life is a person who was trying to push beyond the limitations of her circumstances.
sentences.zh: 但你从她早年面临的挑战中也能看到，她是一个试图突破环境局限的人。

sentences.en: She was one of those people.
sentences.zh: 她是那种人。

sentences.en: She made a plan and she went, that was it.
sentences.zh: 她做好了计划就会去执行，就是这样。

sentences.en: Like, it has to be done this way.
sentences.zh: 就像，事情必须这样完成。

sentences.en: And I'm like, okay.
sentences.zh: 而我就觉得，好吧。

sentences.en: Just seeing how she was wanting to be successful.
sentences.zh: 只要看到她那种想要成功的愿望。

sentences.en: She kind of like drove that into my head.
sentences.zh: 她有点把这种想法灌输到了我的脑子里。

sentences.en: Like, this is what we're going to do.
sentences.zh: 就像，这是我们要做的。

sentences.en: This is how you're going to do it.
sentences.zh: 这就是你要做的方式。

sentences.en: And I'm going to show you how to do it.
sentences.zh: 而我要向你展示如何做到这一点。

sentences.en: We spoke to one of her oldest friends who said that her mom, when they were children, would not let her go to sleepovers at all, except if the sleepover was at Breonna's house.
sentences.zh: 我们采访了她的一位老朋友，她说当他们还是孩子时，布雷娜的妈妈根本不让她去任何人家过夜，除非过夜的地方是布雷娜家。

sentences.en: Why?
sentences.zh: 为什么？

sentences.en: Because Breonna was considered the responsible one.
sentences.zh: 因为布雷娜被认为是那个有责任心的人。

sentences.en: She was the one among their little group of friends who made sure that the other girls got to school on time if there was a sleepover, who made sure that they did their homework.
sentences.zh: 在他们的小朋友圈里，她是那个确保如果在外过夜其他女孩能按时去上学的人，是确保她们完成作业的人。

sentences.en: She seemed to be taking almost an adult role in her immediate circle.
sentences.zh: 在她的朋友圈子里，她似乎扮演着近乎成年人的角色。

sentences.en: Even as a kid, I can remember her being seven years old, saying to my mother, let me check your blood sugar.
sentences.zh: 甚至还是个孩子的时候，我还记得她七岁时对妈妈说，让我来测测你的血糖。

sentences.en: When she was very young, she started to show an interest in medicine and in health care and in helping other people.
sentences.zh: 她很小的时候，就开始对医学、医疗保健以及帮助别人表现出兴趣。

sentences.en: Her mom describes how when Breonna learned that her grandmother had an insulin problem,
sentences.zh: 她的妈妈描述了当布雷娜得知外祖母有胰岛素问题时，

sentences.en: she wanted to prick her grandmother's finger with a needle and draw blood so that she could test her blood sugar level.
sentences.zh: 她想用针扎外祖母的手指抽血，以便测试其血糖水平。

sentences.en: She thought that was interesting and she kept on asking her grandmother if she could do that.
sentences.zh: 她觉得这很有趣，并不停地问外祖母她能不能这么做。

sentences.en: Like, leave her alone.
sentences.zh: 就像，别理她。

sentences.en: But she, my mother would let her stick her finger in and she was like, she was so pumped up to do it and help her do her insulin.
sentences.zh: 但她，我妈妈会让她扎手指，她当时兴奋极了，想要帮忙操作胰岛素。

sentences.en: And I'm like, oh my God.
sentences.zh: 而我就想，我的天呐。

sentences.en: We see that in ninth grade, she begged her mom to give her permission to take the bus and to go start working at a local fast food joint after school.
sentences.zh: 我们看到，在九年级时，她恳求妈妈允许她坐公交车，放学后去当地的一家快餐店打工。

sentences.en: Her friends say that they never really knew her without a job.
sentences.zh: 她的朋友们说，他们从来没见过她没有工作的时候。

sentences.en: She taught me stuff.
sentences.zh: 她教了我很多东西。

sentences.en: My own people, my own siblings, my own mother didn't teach me.
sentences.zh: 我自己的亲人、我自己的兄弟姐妹、我自己的母亲都没有教过我。

sentences.en: And the family I came from, really not supportive.
sentences.zh: 我出身的家庭，实在没什么支持。

sentences.en: So I used to make little Facebook statuses like, who's going to come to my graduation if I had it, even though I know y'all don't really mess with me.
sentences.zh: 所以我以前经常在 Facebook 上发一些状态，比如如果我有毕业典礼谁会来参加，尽管我知道你们其实并不怎么搭理我。

sentences.en: Bre would be like, don't worry about them.
sentences.zh: Bre 就会说，别管他们。

sentences.en: And as long as I'm by your side, that's all that matters, because I'm going to be there.
sentences.zh: 只要我站在你身边，这就足够了，因为我一定会去。

sentences.en: Breonna is the first person in her family to graduate from high school, and she then goes to college.
sentences.zh: 布雷娜是家里第一个高中毕业的人，随后她上了大学。

sentences.en: Tell me how you met.
sentences.zh: 告诉我你们是怎么认识的。

sentences.en: And we met, I guess, on Twitter.
sentences.zh: 我想我们是在 Twitter 上认识的。

sentences.en: In college, she starts a banter on Twitter with another college student.
sentences.zh: 在大学里，她开始和另一名大学生在 Twitter 上开玩笑互动。

sentences.en: Kind of like flirting on the timeline, I guess, so to say.
sentences.zh: 可以说就像是在时间线上打情骂俏吧。

sentences.en: His name was Kenneth Walker.
sentences.zh: 他的名字叫肯尼斯·沃克。

sentences.en: He went by Kenny to all of his friends.
sentences.zh: 他的所有朋友都叫他肯尼。

sentences.en: And she went to the University of Kentucky, and I went to Western Kentucky.
sentences.zh: 她去了肯塔基大学，而我去了西肯塔基大学。

sentences.en: And they start a sort of emoji-filled, flirtatious Twitter banter that, by 2016, evolved into the beginnings of a romance and of a relationship.
sentences.zh: 他们开始了一种充满表情符号、调情式的 Twitter 互动，到 2016 年演变成了一段浪漫恋情和关系的开始。

sentences.en: I kept on telling her I don't want to be friends no more.
sentences.zh: 我一直告诉她我不想再做朋友了。

sentences.en: But we can be if we have to be, but I don't want to be.
sentences.zh: 但如果非得当，我们也可以是，不过我不想。

sentences.en: It was an on-again, off-again relationship.
sentences.zh: 这是一段分分合合的感情。

sentences.en: But what's clear in this back and forth is that Kenny seemed to really have identified her as the person that he wanted to be his life partner.
sentences.zh: 但在这番拉扯中显而易见的是，肯尼似乎真的认定她就是他想要的人生伴侣。

sentences.en: Seems like when nobody else was there for me, she was always there.
sentences.zh: 感觉当没有其他人陪在我身边时，她总是在那儿。

sentences.en: And it was Breonna that wasn't 100% sure about him.
sentences.zh: 而对这段感情并非百分之百确定的反而是布雷娜。

sentences.en: Some days, it was, yeah, let's marry to have a kid.
sentences.zh: 有时，会是，好吧，让我们结婚生个孩子吧。

sentences.en: And the other days, it's like, nah, let's be single and live kid-free lives.
sentences.zh: 而另一些时候，就像是，算了吧，单身过没有孩子的日子吧。

sentences.en: So, there was a million times where I said, I'm not messing with her anymore ever again.
sentences.zh: 所以，有过无数次我说，我再也不要和她纠缠了。

sentences.en: And I'm sure she said the same thing several times.
sentences.zh: 我敢肯定她也说过好几次这样的话。

sentences.en: But everybody we spoke to described him as somebody who genuinely loved her.
sentences.zh: 但我们采访的每个人都将他描述为一个真心爱她的人。

sentences.en: We can be friends, and we can be everything else, too.
sentences.zh: 我们可以做朋友，也可以成为彼此的一切。

sentences.en: So, that's the goal when you're trying to be with somebody or love them, whatever.
sentences.zh: 所以，当你试图和某人在一起或爱他们时，这就是目标。

sentences.en: You want to be friends with them also, and that's rare.
sentences.zh: 你也希望和他们成为朋友，这很难得。

sentences.en: So, if you come across that, I think you should try to take advantage of it.
sentences.zh: 因此，如果你遇到了这种情况，我认为你应该试着好好把握。

sentences.en: What we now know is that a few months after she started dating Kenny in 2016, she also starts seeing another man.
sentences.zh: 我们现在知道的是，在 2016 年开始和肯尼约会几个月后，她也开始和另一个男人交往。

sentences.en: His name is Jamarcus Clover, and by all accounts, he's in many ways the opposite of Kenny.
sentences.zh: 他的名字叫贾马库斯·克洛弗，从各方面来看，他在很多方面与肯尼截然相反。

sentences.en: Jamarcus is a twice-convicted drug dealer.
sentences.zh: 贾马库斯是一个有两次定罪记录的毒贩。

sentences.en: He was sentenced in 2008 when he was 18 years old in Mississippi, his home state, for drug trafficking.
sentences.zh: 他于 2008 年在他老家密西西比州因贩毒被判刑时年仅 18 岁。

sentences.en: And later in 2014, he moves to Kentucky.
sentences.zh: 后来在 2014 年，他搬到了肯塔基州。

sentences.en: He's charged again for drug possession.
sentences.zh: 他又因藏毒被起诉。

sentences.en: And he would spend the next several years in and out of jail.
sentences.zh: 接下来的几年里，他一直在监狱进进出出。

sentences.en: And it bears noting that he seems to enter her life at what was ostensibly a low point.
sentences.zh: 值得一提的是，他似乎是在她明显处于人生低谷时进入她生活的。

sentences.en: She had started college, but she dropped out because she felt homesick and was really missing her family.
sentences.zh: 她开始上大学，但因为想家且非常思念家人而辍学了。

sentences.en: She got her EMT certification and began working as a first responder, riding ambulances.
sentences.zh: 她获得了 EMT（紧急医疗技术员）证书，并作为急救人员开始工作，跟随救护车出勤。

sentences.en: But a year into that job, she quit.
sentences.zh: 但干了一年后，她辞职了。

sentences.en: On social media, she says that she was discouraged by the 16-hour shifts and by the low pay.
sentences.zh: 在社交媒体上，她说她对 16 小时的工作时间和低薪感到沮丧。

sentences.en: And pretty soon into her relationship with Jamarcus, his problems become her probleMs.

sentences.en: When you around, stress a lot.
sentences.zh: 你在的时候，压力很大。

sentences.en: When you around, I stress more.
sentences.zh: 你在的时候，我压力更大。

sentences.en: Because I just always be worried about you.
sentences.zh: 因为我总是为你担心。

sentences.en: I love you.
sentences.zh: 我爱你。

sentences.en: I'm going to call and try to make sure this shit has been found in life.
sentences.zh: 我要打电话试着确保这破事已经在生活中找到了。

sentences.en: I don't know what's going on.
sentences.zh: 我不知道发生了什么。

sentences.en: I woke up.
sentences.zh: 我醒了。

sentences.en: I just call out there.
sentences.zh: 我只是打个电话过去。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: I love you, too.
sentences.zh: 我也爱你。

sentences.en: I love you.
sentences.zh: 我爱你。

sentences.en: I'll call you back and let you know.
sentences.zh: 我待会儿回电话告诉你。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: So Jamarcus gets bailed out, and in the course of the next two months, this newly created squad continues to surveil the trap house at the 2400 block of Elliott.
sentences.zh: 于是贾马库斯保释出狱，在接下来两个月里，这支新成立的小组继续对埃利奥特街2400号街区的毒窝进行监视。

sentences.en: They end up putting a GPS on Jamarcus' car, and that GPS shows that he makes repeated trips in January between the trap house and Breonna Taylor's apartment.
sentences.zh: 他们最终在贾马库斯的车上安了GPS，GPS显示他在一月份频繁往返于毒窝和布丽安娜·泰勒的公寓之间。

sentences.en: They also send police to watch her apartment, and on one day in mid-January, they photograph Jamarcus going into her apartment and emerging from it with a package in his hands
sentences.zh: 他们还派警察去监视她的公寓，在一月中旬的一天，他们拍到贾马库斯走进了她的公寓，手里拿着一个包裹从里面出来，

sentences.en: and then driving straight back to the trap house.
sentences.zh: 然后直接开车回了毒窝。

sentences.en: On another occasion in February, they film her and him arriving in the same car at the trap house.
sentences.zh: 二月份的另一次，他们拍到她和他坐同一辆车抵达毒窝。

sentences.en: He is seen getting out of the driver's side door.
sentences.zh: 可以看到他从驾驶座车门下车。

sentences.en: She is seen getting out of the passenger's side door.
sentences.zh: 可以看到她从副驾驶座车门下车。

sentences.en: He goes into the trap house.
sentences.zh: 他走进了毒窝。

sentences.en: He comes back out, and they drive away together.
sentences.zh: 他又出来了，然后他们一起开车离开。

sentences.en: But the thing that the police had missed as they were carrying out this intense surveillance was the new arc of Breonna Taylor's life that had been building for some time.
sentences.zh: 但警察在执行这项高强度监视时漏掉的一点是，布丽安娜·泰勒的人生正在开启一段酝酿了一段时间的新篇章。

sentences.en: This is messages from January.
sentences.zh: 这是来自一月的短信。

sentences.en: It says, this year I'm coming for everything.
sentences.zh: 上面写着，今年我要得到我想要的一切。

sentences.en: She said, I'm speaking it into existence.
sentences.zh: 她说，我正在用心念让它成为现实。

sentences.en: And she sent two emojis with the fingers crossed and some hearts.
sentences.zh: 她发了两个双手交叉的表情符号和几个爱心。

sentences.en: She was coming for everything she wanted this year.
sentences.zh: 她今年要得到她想要的一切。

sentences.en: 2020 was her year.
sentences.zh: 2020年是属于她的一年。

sentences.en: After leaving her job as an EMT, she got back on her feet, and she got a job as an emergency room technician.
sentences.zh: 在辞去急救医疗技术员的工作后，她重新振作起来，找到了一份急救室技术员的工作。

sentences.en: She picked up a second shift, and she was now working basically two jobs at this ER and at another hospital.
sentences.zh: 她接了第二个班，现在基本上在这家急救室和另一家医院打两份工。

sentences.en: And you see that her life, according to her social media posts, is really on this positive trajectory.
sentences.zh: 你可以看到，根据她的社交媒体动态，她的生活确实处于这种积极的上升轨迹中。

sentences.en: She's bought herself a new car.
sentences.zh: 她给自己买了一辆新车。

sentences.en: She's going to save up for a home.
sentences.zh: 她打算存钱买套房子。

sentences.en: And crucially, in mid-February, she appears to break up for good with Jamarcus Glover.
sentences.zh: 最重要的是，在二月中旬，她似乎与贾马库斯·格洛弗彻底分手了。

sentences.en: And the reason I say for good is there's evidence that's come out since then that indicates that she actually blocked him on her cell phone.
sentences.zh: 我之所以说彻底，是因为有此后流出的证据表明，她其实在手机上把他的电话拉黑了。

sentences.en: These two here, they might as well get married.
sentences.zh: 这俩人干脆结婚算了。

sentences.en: Do you want to be my baby daddy?
sentences.zh: 你想当我孩子的爸吗？

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 想。

sentences.en: Can we go have our baby?
sentences.zh: 我们去生个孩子好吗？

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 好。

sentences.en: When?
sentences.zh: 什么时候？

sentences.en: Today.
sentences.zh: 今天。

sentences.en: Oh.
sentences.zh: 哦。

sentences.en: And from what we know...
sentences.zh: 据我们所知……

sentences.en: Everything was, like, really good.
sentences.zh: 一切都真的很好。

sentences.en: It was great.
sentences.zh: 太棒了。

sentences.en: She seems to commit to Kenny.
sentences.zh: 她似乎对肯尼坚贞不渝。

sentences.en: There was a whole lot of marriage talk and baby talk.
sentences.zh: 有很多关于结婚和生孩子的话题。

sentences.en: We even had baby names and everything.
sentences.zh: 我们甚至连婴儿的名字都取好了，什么都有。

sentences.en: Kenbry, just for the record.
sentences.zh: 声明一下，叫Kenbry。

sentences.en: That was the girl name.
sentences.zh: 那是女孩的名字。

sentences.en: It's Kenny in Remix.
sentences.zh: 是Kenny的变体。

sentences.en: I like that.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢这个名字。

sentences.en: So they're very much launched on what looks to be a serious relationship.
sentences.zh: 所以他们已经正式开始了一段看起来很认真的感情。

sentences.en: Even as these sweeping changes are occurring in Breonna Taylor's life, the police are barreling forward on their investigation.
sentences.zh: 就在布丽安娜·泰勒的生活发生这些翻天覆地的变化时，警方正全力推进他们的调查。

sentences.en: Mm-hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯哼。

sentences.en: And they believe by March that they have enough evidence to hit five locations that are crucial to Jamarcus Glover's criminal syndicate.
sentences.zh: 他们认为到三月份时，他们已经掌握了足够的证据，可以突袭对贾马库斯·格洛弗的犯罪集团至关重要的五个地点。

sentences.en: Four of them are on Elliott Avenue, and around Elliott Avenue.
sentences.zh: 其中四个在埃利奥特大道上以及埃利奥特大道周边。

sentences.en: These are the trap houses that he operated.
sentences.zh: 这些都是他经营的毒窝。

sentences.en: And the fifth is the home of Breonna Tanner.
sentences.zh: 第五个是布丽安娜·坦纳的家。

sentences.en: Tomorrow on The Daily, what happened during the police raid?
sentences.zh: 明天《每日新闻》，警方突袭行动期间发生了什么？

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: Here's what else you need to know today.
sentences.zh: 以下是你今天需要了解的其他新闻。

sentences.en: The chief of police in Rochester, New York, resigned on Tuesday amid growing outrage and widening investigations into the death of Daniel Prude by officers in his department.
sentences.zh: 纽约州罗切斯特市警察局长周二辞职，此前公众对该部门警官导致丹尼尔·普鲁德死亡一事的愤怒日益高涨，调查范围也在不断扩大。

sentences.en: Prude suffocated after police placed a hood over his head and pressed him into the ground for two minutes, a death that Rochester officials did not disclose for months.
sentences.zh: 普鲁德在警察将一个头套套在他头上并把他按在地上两分钟后窒息身亡，罗切斯特官员隐瞒了数月之久才公开这一死讯。

sentences.en: The police chief,
sentences.zh: 警察局长，

sentences.en: Leron Singletary, has denied that the officers involved did anything wrong.
sentences.zh: 勒龙·辛格尔塔里，否认涉案警官有任何不当行为。

sentences.en: And...
sentences.zh: 还有……

sentences.en: It's an unprecedented moment.
sentences.zh: 这是一个前所未有的时刻。

sentences.en: It's a historic pledge.
sentences.zh: 这是一个历史性的承诺。

sentences.en: Nine vaccine makers are coming out saying that they will stand with science.
sentences.zh: 九家疫苗制造商站出来表示，他们将秉持科学精神。

sentences.en: In an unusual public pledge, the CEOs of nine drug companies, including Pfizer,
sentences.zh: 在一次不同寻常的公开承诺中，包括辉瑞在内的九家制药公司的首席执行官，

sentences.en: Moderna, and AstraZeneca, said that they would not distribute a vaccine for the coronavirus until it had been thoroughly vetted for safety and effectiveness.
sentences.zh: 莫德纳和阿斯利康表示，在冠状病毒疫苗的安全性和有效性得到彻底审查之前，他们不会分发该疫苗。

sentences.en: Increasing public concerns about the processes that we are using to develop these vaccines and even more importantly, the processes that will be used to evaluate these vaccines,
sentences.zh: 鉴于公众对我们开发这些疫苗所使用流程的日益担忧，更重要的是对评估这些疫苗所使用流程的担忧，

sentences.en: we saw it as critical to come out and reiterate our commitment that we will develop our products, our vaccines, using the highest ethical standards.
sentences.zh: 我们认为至关重要的是站出来重申我们的承诺，即我们将以最高的道德标准开发我们的产品、我们的疫苗。

sentences.en: The statement appeared to be a response to claims by President Trump that a vaccine would be ready before Election Day, raising fears that the president may rush the process
sentences.zh: 这份声明似乎是对特朗普总统关于疫苗将在选举日前准备就绪的言论的回应，这引发了人们对总统可能会仓促行事的担忧

sentences.en: and undermine public trust in an eventual vaccine.
sentences.zh: 并削弱公众对最终疫苗的信任。

sentences.en: That's it for The Daily.
sentences.zh: 以上就是本期《每日新闻》的全部内容。

sentences.en: I'm Michael Barbaro.
sentences.zh: 我是迈克尔·巴巴罗。

sentences.en: See you tomorrow.
sentences.zh: 明天见。

sentences.en: For decades, the Brooklyn Democratic Party operated as a tightly controlled machine until this summer.
sentences.zh: 几十年来，布鲁克林民主党一直像一台受到严密控制的机器一样运作，直到今年夏天。

sentences.en: When elections ushered in a bunch of self-described reformers.
sentences.zh: 当时选举迎来了群自称改革派的人。

sentences.en: Ever since, the party has been in the grip of a bruising, chaotic, and sometimes thrilling fight.
sentences.zh: 从那以后，该党一直陷入一场激烈、混乱、有时甚至扣人心弦的权力斗争中。

sentences.en: In the latest episode of Metro, with me, Sarah Koenig, stories of people trying to maintain their influence and losing control along the way.
sentences.zh: 在由我莎拉·科尼格主持的最新一期《Metro》节目中，将讲述人们试图维持影响力却在过程中失控的故事。

sentences.en: Metro.
sentences.zh: Metro。

sentences.en: Listen wherever you get your podcasts.
sentences.zh: 请在各大播客平台收听。
